name: standalone italic byline
rationale: claude-opus-5 formats author attribution and dates as standalone italic lines (*Name, Credentials, Title*) on their own line in document headers. claude-sonnet-5 consistently uses bold key-value pairs (**Prepared by:** Name) for the same information. Zero standalone italic attribution lines appear in any sonnet-5 excerpt.

name: bold inline citation
rationale: claude-opus-5 wraps author-year citations in bold (**Author et al. (YEAR)**) when citing studies inline in body text. The sonnet-5 literature review excerpt shows no bold formatting on any inline citation, suggesting a distinct citation-styling habit.

examples: # Program Review Office — FY2025 Annual Cycle
# Consolidation Study — Cascade Ridge School District
## Internal Memorandum Packet — Obstetric Services Consolidation
## 1. Final-Mile Delivery Network — Atlanta and Charlotte
name: em dash heading separator
rationale: claude-opus-5 uses an em dash as the primary structural separator in markdown heading lines (# Title — Descriptor) without any colon, at a 4:1 ratio over sonnet-5. sonnet-5 strongly prefers colons for the same heading-level separation (# Title: Descriptor), which the existing pnc.colon-subtitle-heading entry captures from the other direction.
